dialogs.about: 문에 붙은 전시 포스터를 보고 할아버지와 계획을 세우며

lines.en: Look at this poster on our door.
lines.ko: 우리 문에 붙은 이 포스터를 보세요.

lines.en: Oh, a new exhibit. When does it open?
This Saturday. Entry is free for us.
Good. Is there a lecture that day?
Yes, in the afternoon. The curator will speak.
I will bring my glasses and the pamphlet.
Last time we forgot the audio guide.
Did you read the small caption cards?
Some of them. Please help me this time.
Of course. I am happy to go with you.
Excuse me. Where is the entry line?
Right here. Here is a free pamphlet.
lines.ko: 바로 여기예요. 무료 팸플릿 여기 있어요.

lines.en: Thank you. Can I use an audio guide?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 음성 안내를 쓸 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course. But photography is prohibited inside.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 그런데 안에서는 사진 촬영이 금지예요.

lines.en: I understand. I will put my phone away.
Thank you. Each exhibit has a caption card.
Good. Is the curator here this morning?
She gave a lecture this morning already.
Oh, that's too bad. I will come next time.
Yes. Enjoy the exhibit. Have a good day.
lines.ko: 네. 전시 즐겁게 보세요. 좋은 하루 보내세요.
